Arkansas · Hot Springs Village & Diamondhead excludedProperty Hunter scan

What this is. Every property Property Hunter has found from public records (Garland County, and Saline County as it comes in): the Arkansas GIS tax roll (owner, assessed values, parcel), the City of Hot Springs vacant-structure register, cleanup/demolition liens, 2025 code cases, zoning and FEMA flood maps.

What it is not. There are no asking prices here; none of these are listed for sale. Delinquent taxes have not been checked (the county's tax site is login-only). The value shown is the county's appraised total (the assessor's opinion of full value, often behind the market); tax is charged on 20% of it. Scores are a ranking aid, not a valuation. Nothing here is an offer, and paying someone's taxes never makes you the owner. Known limit: City register entries were matched to parcels by a point lookup, and an audit on 2026-09-13 found about 80 of them sitting on the neighbouring lot. Before acting on any one, confirm the parcel in the live lookup, which reads the parcel itself.

The 22 investigated so far, highest overall score first, each run through all 17 investigation stages. Click one for the findings.
